description: Defines the SpdySessionPool class and related nested classes for managing SPDY sessions, including session requests, creation, lookup, and lifecycle management within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: SpdySessionPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of SPDY sessions, handles session creation, lookup, and lifecycle events, and observes network and SSL configuration changes.

classes.name: SpdySessionRequest
classes.description: Represents a request for a SPDY session with a specific key, with a delegate to notify when the session becomes available.

classes.name: SpdySessionRequest::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for receiving notification when a SPDY session becomes available.

classes.name: GreasedHttp2Frame
classes.description: Struct holding parameters for sending reserved HTTP/2 frames to 'grease' frame types.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::CreateAvailableSessionFromSocketHandle
methods.description: Creates a new SPDY session from an existing socket handle.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::CreateAvailableSessionFromSocket
methods.description: Creates a new SPDY session from a socket stream with connect timing info.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::FindAvailableSession
methods.description: Finds an available SPDY session matching the given key.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::HasAvailableSession
methods.description: Checks if an available session exists for the given key.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::RequestSession
methods.description: Requests a SPDY session, creating a request object and delegate for notification.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::OnHostResolutionComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of host resolution, possibly setting up session aliases.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::MakeSessionUnavailable
methods.description: Marks a session as unavailable in the pool.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::RemoveUnavailableSession
methods.description: Removes an unavailable session from the pool.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::CloseCurrentSessions
methods.description: Closes all current sessions with a specified error.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::CloseAllSessions
methods.description: Closes all sessions, including new ones being created.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::MakeCurrentSessionsGoingAway
methods.description: Marks current sessions as going away.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::GetDnsAliasesForSessionKey
methods.description: Retrieves DNS aliases for a session key.

methods.name: SpdySessionPool::OnSSLConfigForServerChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in SSL config for a specific server.
